scope.description: Whole espeakng application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Multilingual speech synthesis, voices, pronunciation/phonemes, prosody, SSML, output formats and dictionary/language development.

coverage.rationale: Creating speech is central, but most voices, prosody, pronunciation and markup capabilities are not exposed.

scope.description: Short plain-text synthetic narration drafts with rate and four selected voices to canonical PCM16 WAV.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Narration intent and a canonical reusable WAV hide synthesis plumbing; most expressive speech decisions are fixed or unavailable.

limitations: Four closed voice choices and bounded plain text; fixed pitch/amplitude/output; no SSML or phoneme control and no intelligibility or human-quality guarantee.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
